FIFA President Attends U-20 Women's World Cup Opener

FIFA President Gianni Infantino attended the opening match of the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Katowice, Poland. Infantino was present at the tournament's first game. One report noted that he remained silent when asked about his previously abandoned proposal to sell a stake in the World Cup.
